Item 2 no longer gives square footage; it names R&D centers and offices primarily in India, the United States and China and owned and leased manufacturing in Singapore, Germany and China. The only country split with a value is long-lived tangible assets (U.S. $3.0bn vs outside the U.S. $3.8bn at September 27, 2026, from the FY2026 10-K; the September 28, 2025 comparatives are $2.0bn and $3.4bn). Revenue by customer headquarters country is in the records and not repeated. The Wuxi manufacturing site is re-sourced to the 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report (the newest edition on qualcomm.com/company/corporate-responsibility, checked 2026-11-24), which also names a manufacturing site in Munich, Germany. No taxes-by-country report was found.

pay.notes: Employees: Qualcomm reports an approximate count of all full-time, part-time and temporary workers at its fiscal year end.
